recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑之間幾乎沒有脂肪空泡，骨髓腔被均一的細胞浸潤完全填滿（細胞量近 100%），提示 B-ALL 復發造成的骨髓瀰漫性取代；低倍下無法判斷細胞種類。
features: Adequate core with multiple bony trabeculae
Markedly hypercellular marrow approaching 100% cellularity with near-total loss of fat spaces
Diffuse, monotonous infiltrate filling intertrabecular spaces
No discernible normal trilineage architecture or megakaryocyte clusters at this power
Cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy shows multiple bony trabeculae with intervening marrow spaces that are nearly 100% cellular, with almost complete loss of fat. The marrow is diffusely replaced by a monotonous-appearing infiltrate without recognizable normal hematopoietic architecture. Cytologic features cannot be evaluated at this magnification, but in the context of the accompanying high-power and immunohistochemical findings, the appearance is consistent with diffuse marrow involvement by relapsed B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Also produces a packed marrow; distinguished at high power and by immunophenotype (MPO/CD117 vs CD79a/PAX5/TdT).
MPNs retain trilineage maturation with prominent, often clustered megakaryocytes rather than a monotonous infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by lymphoma (e.g., Burkitt or DLBCL)
ddx.vs: Requires high-power cytology and TdT/CD34 negativity with mature B-cell markers to separate from lymphoblastic leukemia.
